title: Atlas ↔ MDS semantic token crosswalk
note: Neutral crosswalk. Neither system is source of truth. Companion to atlas-mds-primitive-crosswalk.json, which covers the primitive tier.
readThisFirst: Three comparison axes give three DIFFERENT answers, so all three are recorded separately. Do not quote one as 'the' result: by name 2 of 145 share a name and neither shares a value; by raw value 4 match of which 2 are cross-category coincidences; by concept 5 agree in light mode and 0 also agree in dark.
method: Atlas resolved through its 3-hop chain semantic -> palette -> primitive (145 of 145 resolved, 0 dangling refs). MDS read from semantic-tokens.ts and tokens.ts. Where Atlas uses alpha, values are additionally composited over Atlas's own page surface (layer.neutral.01) so rendered colour can be compared with MDS's solid hex.

vocabulary.skos:exactMatch: interchangeable; from the W3C SKOS mapping vocabulary
vocabulary.skos:closeMatch: similar enough for some uses; here, deltaE00 <= 5 in both modes
vocabulary.nameCollision: NOT a SKOS relation. The two schemes reuse one name for different values. SKOS assumes schemes do not collide and has no term for this.

caveat: Point-in-time snapshot. The Atlas export is not held alongside MDS, so this cannot be regenerated automatically and will go stale silently if either system changes.

byName.note: Compared after normalising Atlas's dotted paths to MDS's camelCase.

byValue.note: Only 2 of the 4 pair concepts that correspond; the other 2 merely share a value.

alpha.note: The single largest structural difference, and the reason a raw-value diff misleads: Atlas encodes compositing instructions, MDS encodes resolved colours.

conceptAxis.note: MDS's placeholder concept is textTertiary — semantic-tokens.ts:27 comments it 'Tertiary / placeholder', and figma-variable-map-semantic.json binds it to V3/Text & icon/Placeholder. It is UNREACHABLE from any role, so input/textarea/command/input-group fake it with placeholder:opacity-70 and -60 instead.
